summary: CyberChef is a browser-based utility designed to perform data transformation tasks such as encryption, decryption, hashing, and encoding. It provides a web interface where you can chain different operations together to process text and binary data entirely on the client side.
goodFor: Developers, sysadmins, and security analysts who frequently need to decode payloads, inspect hashes, or convert data formats without relying on external online services.
watchOut: Because it processes data entirely within the browser client, heavy operations on very large files can consume significant memory and potentially freeze your browser tab.
deployNotes: As a purely static Javascript application, it typically requires only a basic web server to serve the static files and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
